# Scraping: rvest (todo) {#sec-scraping}

::: {.callout-note}
**Proposed chapter scope:** Web scraping with `rvest`. Covers reading HTML, selecting elements with CSS selectors, and extracting structured data from a single page. Then the code is wrapped in a function and applied to many pages with `map` and `list_rbind`: this is where functions and `map` are first introduced, and where lists first appear (as what `map` returns). A callout shows a `for` loop ("you'll see this in other people's code") next to its `map` equivalent.

webR runs in the browser, so CORS blocks scraping most live sites. Host the practice pages on the book's own site (same origin), so readers still make real HTTP requests to real HTML.
:::
